title: Book Two · Chapter 58: Three Small Marks
story:
On Monday, Miss Wu calls Ronan to the side table. His red cup paper lies beside her hand. Three small marks stand beside the answer spaces.

Ronan counts them before he reads anything else.

“Three right?” he asks.

“Yes. Tell me about the first one.”

Ronan looks at the question. He remembers the big table in the picture.

“The boy puts the cup on the chair.”

She points to the chair. It is near the corner of the picture, almost behind the table.

“And later?”

“The woman puts it on the high shelf.”

Miss Wu turns the paper a little. “You kept the two actions apart.”

Ronan smiles. He wants to look across the room at Leo. Instead, he looks at his last answer. The word empty is still there. A thin line crosses it.

“I nearly got this one wrong.”

“What made you change it?”

“The last line. Some milk is still there.”

“Keep your change on the page,” she says. “You can see your work.”

Ronan takes the paper to his desk. He wants to rub out the crossed word. Then nobody would see his first mistake. But the pencil line is thin and the paper is soft. He puts the rubber away.

Jun comes past on his way to the shelf.

“How was it?”

“Three right,” Ronan says.

Jun nods. “The milk stayed in, then.”

Ronan laughs. “Some of it.”

Jun goes to choose a book. He does not ask about Ronan's place in the class. Ronan looks at the three marks again. He got all three answers right. But the marks do not give him a place in the class.

After school, he shows the paper to Mum. She reads the questions slowly. At the crossed word, her finger stops.

“Is this yours?”

“Yes. I changed it before I gave the page in.”

Mum looks at the final answer. “That cup still has something to drink.”

Ronan puts the page beside his old kite practice. On the older page, the girl waits at the field gate. He does not throw that page away. He puts both sheets in his school folder.

Then he hears a knock. Leo is at the green door with the ball under one arm.

“Can you come?”

Ronan asks Mum. She gives him a short time before supper. He puts the folder down and follows Leo into the yard.

For the first few throws, he keeps thinking about the marks. Then Leo makes a very poor throw. Ronan has to run. The ball goes under a chair. For now, he forgets the three marks. His paper is inside with his school things.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

mark＝记号；change＝更改；answer＝答案。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan这次练习实际做得怎样？
2. 他为什么保留划掉的词？

## 读句子

**She / points / to the chair.** 她／指向／那把椅子。
